description: This file defines functions and types for interacting with Tavily's web search and extraction APIs, including caching mechanisms, URL resolution, and content wrapping.

methods.name: resolveEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves a full URL by appending a pathname to a base URL, handling empty or invalid base URLs.

methods.name: runTavilySearch
methods.description: Performs a web search using Tavily's API with specified parameters, utilizing caching and content wrapping.

methods.name: runTavilyExtract
methods.description: Extracts content from specified URLs using Tavily's API with caching and content wrapping.
